description: This file implements HTTP request logging for Kubernetes API server, including a respLogger struct that wraps http.ResponseWriter to track request metrics, errors, and stack traces, with functions for logging, context management, and request handling.

classes.name: respLogger
classes.description: A wrapper around http.ResponseWriter that logs request details, status, errors, and stack traces, with thread-safe access and configurable stacktrace logging.

classes.name: passthroughLogger
classes.description: A simple logger that logs immediately to klog when Addf is called.

methods.name: StacktraceWhen
methods.description: Sets the predicate to determine when to log a stacktrace.

methods.name: Addf
methods.description: Adds formatted info to the request log.

methods.name: AddKeyValue
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the request log.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs the request details, including latency, status, and additional info.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the response, recording status if not already set.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Records the status code and writes the header.

methods.name: recordStatus
methods.description: Records the response status and logs stack trace if predicate matches.
